class.name: IfcContext
class.brief_description: IfcContext is the generalization of a project context in which objects, type objects, property sets, and properties are defined. The IfcProject as subtype of IfcContext provides the context for all information on a construction project, it may include one or several IfcProjectLibrary as subtype of IfcContext to register the included libraries for the project. Context of the representations used within the context.
